```{r}
cell_ID_a <- "CX1"
cell_ID_b <- "CX2"
treated_a <- TRUE
treated_b <- FALSE
num_cells_before_a <- 5415
num_cells_before_b <- 8123
num_cells_after_a <- 1432
num_cells_after_b <- 7543
```
```{r}
cell_id_vec <- c(cell_ID_a, cell_ID_b )
treated_vec <- c(treated_a, treated_b)
num_cells_before_vec <- c(num_cells_before_a, num_cells_before_b)
num_cells_after_vec <- c(num_cells_after_a, num_cells_after_b)

```
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_chicken <- all_my_pets[4]
                        
print(my_chicken)
```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble (
  cell_ID = cell_id_vec,
  treated = treated_vec,
  Num_cells_before = num_cells_before_vec,
  Num_cells_after = num_cells_after_vec
  
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
